scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is the primary evidence; finite checker runs are supplementary and cannot certify the infinite statement. No external or independent mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact Eisenstein multiplicity band is for N divisible by three and only below the sharp cutoff; the CDF theorem holds for every N and concerns uniform character counting, not individual gaps. The unrestricted divisor formula is classical, and full text of Pinsky (1980) was inaccessible for comparison; historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp Eisenstein multiplicity band and spectral cusp for homogeneous Fourier shells on the three-torus
